newsitem.title: USA: Agouron sets shareholder rights plans.
newsitem.headline: Agouron sets shareholder rights plans.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan.
The company said the plan is designed to let shareholders realize the long-term value of their investment in Agouron and guard against unfair takeover attempts.
The plan provides for the distribution of one preferred stock purchase right as a dividend for each share of common stock held of record at the close of business on November 21.

The rights, which will initially trade with the common stock, become exercisable at $500.00 per right if a third party acquires 15 percent or more of Agouron's common stock or announces a tender offer that would result in such party owning 15 percent or more of Agouron's common stock.
The company said the rights expire November 21, 2006.
Agouron said the plan is not a response to any current effort to acquire control of the company.
Agouron develops technologies that enable the atom-by-atom design of novel synthetic drugs based upon the molecular structures of target proteins that play key roles in human disease.
